card.name: The before risk in warnings
card.fires_on: The word "the" right before "risk" in warning sentences, such as after "To reduce" or "To minimize", or after a comma that follows a long "While...can occur" clause about respiratory depression.

modes.label: After a comma in opioid warning
modes.description: "the" opens the main clause "the risk is greatest during initiation" after a "While...can occur at any time" clause.
modes.example: any time during the use of Hydrocodone Bitartrate and Homatropine Methylbromide Oral Solution (Syrup),<< the>> risk is greatest during the initiation of therapy

modes.label: After reduce or minimize
modes.description: "the" follows "To reduce" or "To minimize" and comes before a risk phrase.
